title: C: Simple Hash Function
description: Implement a simple non-cryptographic hash function (djb2) and a basic checksum utility.

steps.title: djb2 Hash
steps.description: Implement the djb2 hash function: `unsigned long djb2(char *str)` with hash = 5381, then for each char: `hash = hash * 33 + c`. Print the hash of 'hello', 'world', and 'hello' (should be same for identical strings).
